dnd-5e-craft.demo.built: The Broken Blade and ruined crypt are ready at %s, %s, %s.
dnd-5e-craft.dialogue.builtin.morgan.gre: Stand where I can see your hands. What brings you to my crypt?
dnd-5e-craft.dialogue.builtin.morgan.par: Offer a truce and ask about the stolen payroll.
dnd-5e-craft.dialogue.builtin.morgan.rea: Threaten to tell the town guard where his crew is hiding.
dnd-5e-craft.dialogue.builtin.morgan.par: The payroll is in the war chest. Take word to the town and we’ll speak again.
dnd-5e-craft.dialogue.builtin.morgan.rea: You won’t need the guard. My sentries won’t pursue you through the arch.
dnd-5e-craft.dialogue.builtin.morgan.ref: Fine. When that horn sounds, my crew will be waiting.
dnd-5e-craft.dialogue.builtin.boris.gree: Welcome to the Broken Blade. A guard’s payroll vanished near the old crypt.
dnd-5e-craft.dialogue.builtin.boris.parl: Ask Boris who took the payroll.
dnd-5e-craft.dialogue.builtin.boris.read: Ask why Boris keeps glancing at the doorway.
dnd-5e-craft.dialogue.builtin.boris.parl: Morgan Blackfang took it. Follow the gravel path south to his crypt.
dnd-5e-craft.dialogue.builtin.boris.read: His men strung a poison trap across the arch. Search the floor before you cross.
dnd-5e-craft.dialogue.builtin.boris.refu: I can sell you a drink. Leave the rest alone.
